blocks.prompt: 10. Prove by mathematical induction that if a loan of Rs. 2,000,000 and pay Rs. 50,000 at the end of each year, the remaining balance after n years is \(R_n = 2{,}000{,}000 - 50{,}000n\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh qarz (loan) ka sawal hai: Rs. 2,000,000 ka qarz har saal Rs. 50,000 ki adayigi se kam hota hai. Sawal mein interest (sood) ka zikr nahi, is liye sirf adayigi ghatayenge.
Saabit karna hai ke \(n\) saal baad baqi raqam ka formula sahi hai.
Plan: rule \(R_{k+1} = R_k - 50{,}000\); pehle saal ka base case; phir inductive step. Sawal ki angrezi thori adhuri hai ("if a loan ... and pay"), matlab yeh hai ke koi Rs. 2,000,000 ka qarz le aur har saal Rs. 50,000 ada kare.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: qarz Rs. 2,000,000; har saal ke aakhir mein Rs. 50,000 ki adayigi.
Saabit karna hai: \(S(n): R_n = 2{,}000{,}000 - 50{,}000n\) har positive integer \(n\) ke liye (jab tak qarz khatam na ho).
Tareeqa: Pehle saalana rule, phir mathematical induction.

Alfaaz ko rule mein badlein
\[R_{k+1} = R_k - 50{,}000\]
Kyun: Har saal ki adayigi baqi raqam ko Rs. 50,000 kam kar deti hai. Yani agle saal ki baqi raqam = is saal ki baqi raqam minus 50,000.

Base case: \(n = 1\)
\[R_1 = 2{,}000{,}000 - 50{,}000 = 1{,}950{,}000\]
\[2{,}000{,}000 - 50{,}000(1) = 1{,}950{,}000\]
Is liye \(S(1)\) sahi hai.
Kyun: Pehli adayigi ke baad baqi raqam qarz minus ek adayigi hai, aur formula mein \(n = 1\) rakhne se bhi wahi 1,950,000 aata hai. Yeh pehla domino hai.

Induction hypothesis: \(S(k)\) ko sahi maan lein
\[R_k = 2{,}000{,}000 - 50{,}000k \quad (A)\]
Kyun: Farz kiya ke \(k\) saal baad formula sahi baqi raqam deta hai. Is farz ko saabit nahi karte; agle qadam mein sirf istemal karte hain.

Inductive step: pehle rule, phir (A)
\[R_{k+1} = R_k - 50{,}000\]
\[= 2{,}000{,}000 - 50{,}000k - 50{,}000\]
\[= 2{,}000{,}000 - 50{,}000(k + 1)\]
Kyun: Rule mein \(R_k\) ki jagah (A) rakha. Phir \(-50{,}000k - 50{,}000\) mein \(-50{,}000\) common nikala: \(-50{,}000(k + 1)\). Yeh bilkul target hai.
Dhyan dein: Common nikalte waqt doosri term ka 1 na bhoolein: \(50{,}000 = 50{,}000 \times 1\).

Conclusion
\(S(1)\) sahi hai aur \(S(k)\) se \(S(k + 1)\) sahi hota hai. Principle of mathematical induction se \(R_n = 2{,}000{,}000 - 50{,}000n\) har positive integer \(n\) ke liye sahi hai, jab tak qarz ada na ho jaye.
Kyun: Induction ki dono sharten poori ho gayin.

Tasdeeq: qarz kab khatam hoga?
\[2{,}000{,}000 - 50{,}000n = 0\]
\[n = 40\]
Kyun: 40 adayigiyon ke baad baqi raqam zero ho jati hai. Is ke baad formula negative raqam dega, jis ka koi matlab nahi; is liye formula \(1 \le n \le 40\) ke liye hai.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(n\) saal baad baqi raqam \(R_n = 2{,}000{,}000 - 50{,}000n\) hai (\(n \le 40\) tak).
